test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Colleagues Karna, Michelli, Prabhu, Vanaja, Mohan, Raghu, Jockey and Neelima are sitting around a square table in such way that four of them sit at corners and four of them at the middle of the sides. The ones who sit at the corners face outside (opposite to the centre) and the ones who sit at the middle of the sides face towards centre. Vanaja is seated third to the right of Jockey. Vanaja faces towards the centre. Mohan is third to the left of Prabhu. Prabhu is not sitting at middle of any of the sides. Only one person sits between Mohan and Raghu. Raghu is not an immediate neighbour of Prabhu. Neelima faces towards the centre. Karna is not an immediate neighbour of Raghu.

Who is an immediate neighbour of both Mohan and Raghu?
solution:
Colleagues Karna, Michelli, Prabhu, Vanaja, Mohan, Raghu, Jockey and Neelima are sitting around a square table in such way that four of them sit at corners and four of them at the middle of the sides. The ones who sit at the corners face outside (opposite to the centre) and the ones who sit at the middle of the sides face towards centre.

1) Mohan is third to the left of Prabhu. Prabhu is not sitting at middle of any of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ced07f64f5a12f639424d4c1a08403460794ff62c60422252531dba39619345.png] 

2) Only one person sits between Mohan and Raghu. Raghu is not an immediate neighbour of Prabhu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f0eac42458df609522ddeecd244e7341f2b7d0d27ef44e9e0f0d61a51b05ebe.png] 

3) Vanaja is seated third to the right of Jockey. Vanaja faces towards the centre.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a28d4a92567dc011a9d4363561680c27118c34df47228b6f8773d3562c6b04ad.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69d897375a0985987f67b1f002504eb0179dfb19ecde1d5865a5a2c00085c472.png] 

4) Neelima faces towards the centre. Karna is not an immediate neighbour of Raghu.

 
• Therefore, case (ii) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea43626ed6face14637892a92333fea26db96a709fe25d6ee5f5fa0306058f00.png] 

∴ Here, 'Jockey' is immediate neighbour of both Mohan and Raghu.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Jockey".**
